newsitem.title: USA: US spot propane firms on NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: US spot propane firms on NYMEX.

text.p: U.S. spot propane prices rose in quiet trade on Friday amid an upward push by NYMEX futures, players said.
The rise, however, was not a full retracement from Thursday's losses following bearish inventory data recording a 7.9 million barrel gain in propane stocks last month.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane firmed a quarter cent to between 34.00 cents and 34.25 cents a gallon. 34.125 cent deals were done.
Conway, Kansas, material rose a half cent to 35.75/36.00 cents.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
